deliverables.what: sections/11_related.md rewritten -- six lines of related work, every citation cross-verified against two independent sources
the bibliography REVIEW E2 asks for; records that could not be confirmed twice are absent rather than hedged
sections/07_battery.md re-derived against battery v2; every number read from battery/artifacts/*.json
REVIEW.md open items triaged by cost of fix: writing / re-derive / new experiment

method.literature: six parallel subagents, one per line of related work, each required to cross-verify every bibliographic record against two independent sources and to record the exact URLs and what each confirmed; a record confirmable only once was dropped
method.adversarial_check: two independent re-check passes over samples of the confirmed set, chosen adversarially rather than randomly
method.battery: numbers read directly from battery/artifacts/*.json rather than transcribed from battery/REPORT_V2.md prose; report-only statements are attributed to the report

network.why: bibliographic verification only -- DOI resolution, catalogue and proceedings lookups
